panel.summary: The App token handed to the now-live iterate fixer is minted with the installation's FULL permission set, unlike the review-panel fixer which deliberately narrows it
panel.evidence: agent-review-panel.yml:375-381 narrows the same App token to `permission-contents/pull-requests/issues: write` with the explicit rationale "this token is used in a job that checks out and executes untrusted branch code". agent-iterate-ci.yml:55-60 mints the token with no `permission-*` narrowing at all, then persists it into .git/config (line 62-66, no persist-credentials:false), runs the branch's own lockfile lifecycle scripts (line 125) and the branch's own scripts/agent/summarize-ci.mjs (line 143), and finally hands the token to the agent as `github_token` (line 154). Every extra scope the installation holds (per agent-implement.yml:81 it holds at least Administration:read; claude-code-action installations commonly hold Checks/Actions write) is therefore exposed to branch-controlled code and to a prompt-injectable agent. This diff is what makes that job's agent step actually execute.
panel.finding_key: .github/workflows/agent-iterate-ci.yml::the app token handed to the now-live iterate fixer is minted with the installation's full permission set, unlike the review-panel fixer which deliberately narrows it
